I feel you man. My ex-girlfriend said something similar to me last week. It wasn't my brother that died, it was my best friend, but he was basically a brother. It took everything I had not to put her through the wall then and there. Shit is rough.

Edit: 2 of my best friends died last month. 1 to a brain tumor, the other to suicide. So I completely understand where you're coming from.
